name: learning-orchestrator
description: Shared lessons, learning records, knowledge notes and original-question review workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, teach, and review a course graph locally.
interface.longDescription: Builds context packs from structured course material, tracks learning evidence in SQLite, and visualizes the curriculum graph and review progress.
interface.defaultPrompt: Resume the relevant LO position and handle the requested lesson preparation, record analysis, knowledge organization or original-question review using only the current scope.
